cases: Keep all archived blind L1 triggers. The most recent initial update wins overlapping targets.
periods: Fit 2017–2024, calibrate 2025 H1, select 2025 H2, evaluate H1 2026 after all choices.
wind_clock: Native L1 UTC bins. Each target hour begins after issue and ends within six hours. Delay proxies are 5, 15 or 30 minutes after minute closure.

labels.minute_mean: Arithmetic mean of measured minute Bt and mean of max(-Bz,0), matching active verification.
labels.hourly_vector: Norm of the hourly mean magnetic vector and max(-mean Bz,0), matching the active models’ original targets.

selection: Minimize mean Brier for 10 and 15 nT on 2025 H2. Calibrated persistence competes as a minimal candidate.
alerts: If available, select each model’s alert cutoff on 2025 H2 with 5% false positive budget. Use 0.5 when there are no positive labels for that threshold.
fallback: Keep regular forecast when recent native inputs are insufficient.
catalog: Catalog associations are used solely for retrospective subgroup scoring.
catalog_strict_45m: The detected L1 front is within 45 minutes of the independent L1 catalog entry.
